title: Seeded interactive canvas artwork
objective: Measure whether the canvas-generative-art craftbook locks an aesthetic direction and ships a complete animated canvas page.
prompt: In the `Canvas Art Eval` project, build `index.html`: a self-contained generative canvas artwork called "Harbor Current". It should use a seeded pseudo-random generator, draw layered wave/particle forms on a canvas, animate subtly with requestAnimationFrame, include Regenerate and Pause controls, and show the seed on screen. Inline CSS and JS only; no external assets.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for canvas-generative-art. The only deliverable is workspace/index.html.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce a complete animated canvas artwork with seed display, controls, and substantial inline CSS/JS.

success.summary: index.html is a complete animated canvas page with seed and control vocabulary.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Layout and hierarchy fit the content; sections are scannable and coherent.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Seeded source content is used faithfully — no invented facts or dropped requirements.

axes.name: interactivity
axes.description: Controls and states the page claims to offer actually work.

axes.name: polish
axes.description: Styling is intentional and responsive rather than unstyled or broken.
